kpis.name: Gross margin
kpis.convention: Revenue = the REVENUE section (sales and services); other income is excluded.
kpis.nm_note: Not meaningful when revenue is zero.

kpis.name: Operating margin
kpis.convention: EBIT = revenue + other income - cost of sales - operating expenses - depreciation and amortisation.
kpis.nm_note: Not meaningful when revenue is zero.

kpis.name: EBITDA margin
kpis.formula: ((flow("REVENUE") + flow("OTHER_INCOME") - flow("COST_OF_SALES") - flow("OPERATING_EXPENSES") - flow("DEPRECIATION_AMORTISATION")) + flow("DEPRECIATION_AMORTISATION")) / flow("REVENUE")
kpis.nm_note: Not meaningful when revenue is zero.

kpis.name: Net margin
kpis.formula: (flow("REVENUE") + flow("OTHER_INCOME") - flow("COST_OF_SALES") - flow("OPERATING_EXPENSES") - flow("DEPRECIATION_AMORTISATION") + flow("INT.INCOME") - flow("INT.EXPENSE") - flow("FX.DIFF") - flow("TAX")) / flow("REVENUE")
kpis.convention: Net income = EBIT + interest income - interest expense - exchange differences - income tax.
kpis.nm_note: Not meaningful when revenue is zero.

kpis.name: Return on assets
kpis.formula: (flow("REVENUE") + flow("OTHER_INCOME") - flow("COST_OF_SALES") - flow("OPERATING_EXPENSES") - flow("DEPRECIATION_AMORTISATION") + flow("INT.INCOME") - flow("INT.EXPENSE") - flow("FX.DIFF") - flow("TAX")) * annual_factor() / (avg_balance("CURRENT_ASSETS") + avg_balance("NON_CURRENT_ASSETS"))
kpis.convention: Net income annualised (x 365 / days in the period) over average total assets (mean of opening and closing).
kpis.nm_note: Not meaningful when average total assets are zero.
kpis.example: Quarterly net income 25 (100 a year) on average assets 1,000: 10%.

kpis.name: Return on equity
kpis.formula: divide_positive((flow("REVENUE") + flow("OTHER_INCOME") - flow("COST_OF_SALES") - flow("OPERATING_EXPENSES") - flow("DEPRECIATION_AMORTISATION") + flow("INT.INCOME") - flow("INT.EXPENSE") - flow("FX.DIFF") - flow("TAX")) * annual_factor(), avg_balance("EQUITY"))
kpis.convention: Net income annualised over average equity; equity includes this year's result not yet closed.
kpis.nm_note: Not meaningful when average equity is zero or negative.
kpis.example: Net income 100 a year on average equity 500: 20%.
kpis.nm_reason: Average equity is zero or negative

kpis.name: Current ratio
kpis.convention: Balances at the end of the period.
kpis.nm_note: Not meaningful when there are no current liabilities.

kpis.name: Quick ratio
kpis.convention: Cash and trade receivables (no short-term investment line in the taxonomy yet) over current liabilities.
kpis.nm_note: Not meaningful when there are no current liabilities.

kpis.name: Cash ratio
kpis.convention: Cash and equivalents over current liabilities, at the end of the period.
kpis.nm_note: Not meaningful when there are no current liabilities.

kpis.name: Cash runway
kpis.convention: Cash at the end of the period over the average monthly net decrease in cash over the 3 months to that date.
kpis.nm_note: Not meaningful when cash did not decrease over those 3 months (not burning cash).
kpis.example: Cash 90,000; cash fell by 30,000 in 3 months (10,000 a month): 9 months.
kpis.nm_reason: Not burning cash: it did not decrease over the last 3 months

kpis.name: Days sales outstanding
kpis.convention: Average trade receivables (mean of opening and closing) over revenue, times the calendar days in the period. Revenue includes all sales, as credit sales are not tagged.
kpis.nm_note: Not meaningful when revenue is zero.
kpis.example: Average receivables 50 on quarterly revenue 450 over 90 days: 10 days.

kpis.name: Days payables outstanding
kpis.convention: Average trade payables over cost of sales (the default convention; purchases can be approved as an alternative later), times the days in the period.
kpis.nm_note: Not meaningful when cost of sales is zero.
kpis.example: Average payables 30 on cost of sales 270 over 90 days: 10 days.

kpis.name: Days inventory outstanding
kpis.convention: Average inventory over cost of sales, times the days in the period.
kpis.nm_note: Not meaningful when cost of sales is zero.
kpis.example: Average inventory 60 on cost of sales 270 over 90 days: 20 days.

kpis.name: Cash conversion cycle
kpis.formula: avg_balance("BS.AR") / flow("REVENUE") * days() + avg_balance("BS.INVENTORY") / flow("COST_OF_SALES") * days() - avg_balance("BS.AP") / flow("COST_OF_SALES") * days()
kpis.convention: DSO + DIO - DPO, each by its own convention.
kpis.nm_note: Not meaningful when revenue or cost of sales is zero.
kpis.nm_reason: Revenue or cost of sales is zero

kpis.name: Revenue growth
kpis.convention: Against the same period one year earlier.
kpis.nm_note: Not meaningful when the comparative is zero.
kpis.nm_reason: The same period a year earlier is zero

kpis.name: EBITDA growth
kpis.formula: (((flow("REVENUE") + flow("OTHER_INCOME") - flow("COST_OF_SALES") - flow("OPERATING_EXPENSES") - flow("DEPRECIATION_AMORTISATION")) + flow("DEPRECIATION_AMORTISATION")) - ((prior_flow("REVENUE") + prior_flow("OTHER_INCOME") - prior_flow("COST_OF_SALES") - prior_flow("OPERATING_EXPENSES") - prior_flow("DEPRECIATION_AMORTISATION")) + prior_flow("DEPRECIATION_AMORTISATION"))) / abs(((prior_flow("REVENUE") + prior_flow("OTHER_INCOME") - prior_flow("COST_OF_SALES") - prior_flow("OPERATING_EXPENSES") - prior_flow("DEPRECIATION_AMORTISATION")) + prior_flow("DEPRECIATION_AMORTISATION")))
kpis.convention: Against the same period one year earlier; the change is divided by the absolute comparative, so growth from a loss reads correctly.
kpis.nm_note: Not meaningful when the comparative is zero.
kpis.nm_reason: The same period a year earlier is zero

kpis.name: Net profit growth
kpis.formula: ((flow("REVENUE") + flow("OTHER_INCOME") - flow("COST_OF_SALES") - flow("OPERATING_EXPENSES") - flow("DEPRECIATION_AMORTISATION") + flow("INT.INCOME") - flow("INT.EXPENSE") - flow("FX.DIFF") - flow("TAX")) - (prior_flow("REVENUE") + prior_flow("OTHER_INCOME") - prior_flow("COST_OF_SALES") - prior_flow("OPERATING_EXPENSES") - prior_flow("DEPRECIATION_AMORTISATION") + prior_flow("INT.INCOME") - prior_flow("INT.EXPENSE") - prior_flow("FX.DIFF") - prior_flow("TAX"))) / abs((prior_flow("REVENUE") + prior_flow("OTHER_INCOME") - prior_flow("COST_OF_SALES") - prior_flow("OPERATING_EXPENSES") - prior_flow("DEPRECIATION_AMORTISATION") + prior_flow("INT.INCOME") - prior_flow("INT.EXPENSE") - prior_flow("FX.DIFF") - prior_flow("TAX")))
kpis.convention: Against the same period one year earlier, divided by the absolute comparative.
kpis.nm_note: Not meaningful when the comparative is zero.
kpis.nm_reason: The same period a year earlier is zero

kpis.name: Debt to equity
kpis.convention: Current and non-current borrowings over equity (including this year's result not yet closed), at the end of the period.
kpis.nm_note: Not meaningful when equity is zero or negative.

kpis.name: Interest coverage
kpis.convention: EBIT over interest expense for the period.
kpis.nm_note: Not meaningful when there is no interest expense.
